bsort_jit_over_capacity.reason: xpost-mcu-elf: image is 12956 bytes but slot 0x40380200 holds 8192; refusing to truncate
bsort_jit_over_capacity.note: Exceeds both the exec_bench 8192-byte slot and the 3584-byte RX slot. AOT bsort (1900-byte image) and rBPF bsort (4952-byte bytecode) both fit the 8192 slot and were measured.

rbpf_map_index_pure_compute.reason: pack --map-index --obj fails closed: 'no map relocations found; the image carries [workload] but no reference to them'. These programs declare the carrier map but call no helpers, so there is nothing to rewrite.
rbpf_map_index_pure_compute.resolution: Packed with the reference plain pack command (interp_exec_bench.py): pack --image <xdp.bin> --bpf-toml <toml> --machine 1. All eight loaded and produced correct outputs.

rbpf_helper_map_binding.reason: The helper_loop ran but every map lookup returned null: the counters map stayed 0 across 100 flights (AOT and JIT counters reached 100 with the same metadata). exec_bench boots through XdpRt::switch (xpost/src/xdp/mod.rs:492), which copies the cold image bytes raw and never calls apply_map_addresses. The interpreter map-index-to-address patch exists only in the hot-swap stage path (xpost/src/xdp/swap.rs:173, with a fail-closed guard). On the cold switch path the lddw map index is never resolved, so the helper receives a null pointer.
rbpf_helper_map_binding.note: The 122486 ns batch figure measures 8 null-returning lookups per flight, not 8 successful lookup+update; it is NOT a valid helper cost and is not reported as one. The pure-compute rBPF workloads are unaffected (no map references). xpost is not modifiable in this task; reaching the stage path needs an xdp switch handler exec_bench does not register.

hal_helper_loop.reason: exec_bench_hal::run_hal implements opcodes 0..7 only; there is no native helper_loop twin. By design, not a failure.
